notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[b]Greetings everybody![/b]

Some changes:
[list]
[*] fixed typos in hints  for mini-games
[*] fixed a bug with location while changing inventory
[*] achievements are now saved when replaying the game in the achievement book
[*] replaced the shell - now the knife cuts the cheese :)
[*] increased item hit boxes in some mini-locations and puzzles
[*] fixed a lot of tooltip bugs
[*] now you can speed up the scrolling of titles by holding LMB
[/list]

notes.title: Christmas update
notes.content:
[b]Ho-ho-ho Merry Christmas![/b]

Have fun!
